Subject: Venture Scout credit activation & eligibility verification — AccelerateFund cohort

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking our call last week. AccelerateFund is preparing our next scout cohort (ALPHA-22) and we'd like to enable self-serve free credits for the scouts and a handful of portfolio companies so they can kick off with Redwood during onboarding.

What we need from your side:
- Confirmation of eligibility rules (max credits per company, redemption window).
- A short attestation template we can sign that confirms the startups meet the program criteria.
- Activation link or instructions so scouts can claim credits without a manual support ticket.

We attached a short list of the first 8 startups and initial program dates. Can you advise next steps and expected lead time for issuance? We're hoping to have everything live by Mar 8.

Thanks — appreciate it.

— Samir Rao
Head of Programs, AccelerateFund
attachments: accelerator_eligibility_request.csv

Samir / Julia,

Thanks — and great to see the list. We're happy to support the scout cohort. Quick summary of what we can provide for a self-serve activation:

- Program template: 50,000 tokens per startup, valid for 90 days from issuance.
- One-click claim flow (URL) that ties redemptions to a HubSpot partner record for reporting.
- Attestation: we need a signed statement from AccelerateFund confirming program eligibility (we've attached a short PDF form you can sign).

Next steps:
1) Fill & sign the attached "accelerator_eligibility_form.pdf" and return.
2) We'll create the HubSpot record and generate a self-serve activation link (typical lead time: 1–2 business days after we receive the signed form).

I cc'ed Karthik (partner integrations) and Monica (program ops) to help with the HubSpot mapping and the issuance schedule. If you need faster turnaround we can expedite but will need the signed attestation by EOD Wed.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sales Partnerships — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0184

Thanks for the fast help.

Samir — received, thank you. I've provisionally created the HubSpot partner record and linked the signed attestation (HubSpot id AF-2026-1372). Attached are the self-serve activation steps we recommend; we can swap the link into your slides once the record is live.

Key details:
- Per-company allocation: 50,000 tokens (non-transferable).
- Redemption window: 90 days.
- Concurrent claim limits: unlimited claims, but we apply a soft rate limit of 10 requests/sec for automated safety — should be fine for a cohort signup.
- Escalation: if any company needs more tokens, file a quick internal request via the HubSpot record and include the use case.

Self-serve claim link (provisional): https://redwood.app/credits/claim?program=AF-2026-1372
(We will flip this from provisional to active once the attestation is recorded in our system — ETA: 24 hours)

Attachments: issuance_instructions.txt — includes copy you can paste into the slides and the claim flow screenshot.

If it's critical to have the link active before your session, Monica can manually issue the credits to the two flagged startups today. Monica — can you confirm?

Thanks,
Neha
